title: fix(objectql)!: a stored field's declared expression is computed on every write, so a paid invoice's line amount and total stay frozen
body:
Refs #24619 (item a)

Clause-②: no (narrowing) (either shape narrows what a write of a derived stored value is accepted as: a locked value stays locked, or a declared computation is enforced; it owes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review on the narrowing face before the queue)

Row (a) only. Rows (b) (`packages/rest`, `HookConditionError`) and (c) (`service-external-datasource`, `listRemoteTables`) are not touched here; #24619 remains open for them.

## What changes

A field that is not a `formula` and declares `expression` is a stored computed column: it has a column, so a `summary` can roll it up. The engine evaluated `expression` for `formula` fields only, so the value a client sent for such a field was stored as-is. Now `@objectstack/objectql` computes it on every write, so a client-sent value never stands (shape B).

- **Insert** (`insert`, batch insert, `insertMany`): computed over the defaulted row before the `beforeInsert` hooks, so a hook is handed the stored value. It is computed again over the final row, after the hooks and the strips and before validation and the driver.
- **Update by id**: computed over the stored row merged with the caller's patch, before `beforeUpdate`, written onto the raw payload (never through the hook-write recording) and never onto a `readonly` key the #16344 hide pass withheld, so the hooks see the expression over the pre-strip row (a `readonly` key the caller sent stays withheld from the hooks) and the read-only strips still judge the caller's submission. It is computed again after the hooks and both read-only strips, so a locked input that the `readonlyWhen` strip took back out feeds the stored value, never the caller's. A key the caller sent is overwritten. A key the patch does not carry is added only when the computed value differs from the stored one.
- **Predicate update** (`multi: true`): one patch reaches every matched row (the D7 `readPriorRows` memo, no second read). The computed value is stored when it is the same on every row. A patch that moves no input leaves the column alone and drops the caller's value. A patch that would compute different values on different rows is refused with `VALIDATION_FAILED` before anything is written. The field error is `invalid_value` and names the field. Its per-row `beforeUpdate` hooks run before the settle and are handed the caller's patch.
- One evaluator: the read path's `applyFormulaPlan`, planned by the same entry builder as the `formula` read plan (`formulaPlanEntry`, factored out of `planFormulaProjection`). The scale rounding, the one hop, the `can()` permission map and the once-per-field fault report are the read's. An expression that does not evaluate stores `null`, as a `formula` reads `null`.
- No new export, class member, spec key or error code. The new helpers are module-level functions in `engine.ts`.
- `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`: the `expression` describe and TSDoc now say what the key means on a `formula` field and on a stored field. This is a `domain:spec` file, declared to that lane by the claim. `content/docs/references/**` was regenerated (`gen:docs`).
- Both examples' comments (`showcase_invoice_line.amount`, `crm_opportunity_line_item.amount`) now say what the server does. No metadata changed. `amount` needs no `readonlyWhen` of its own: on a paid invoice, the locked inputs keep it frozen.
- Changeset: `minor` for `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/spec`, with a **BREAKING** banner, FROM / TO / Fix, and an `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker.

## Measurement (M, a booted composition)

The showcase and the CRM were booted with `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` and driven over HTTP. Before: `origin/main` at `f89d29e382`. After: this branch.

| Write (showcase, line of the PAID INV-1003, qty 6 × 49.99) | before: line amount / invoice total | after: line amount / invoice total |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `POST /api/v1/batch` update `{quantity:60, amount:2999.40}`, atomic | 2999.4 / **2999.4** (quantity dropped `readonly_when`) | 299.94 / **299.94** (quantity dropped `readonly_when`) |
| `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_invoice_line/ID {"amount":1}` | 1 / **1** | 299.94 / **299.94** |

| Write (showcase, draft INV-1002, the unpaid control) | before | after |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `PATCH {"amount":5}` | amount 5, total 5 | amount unchanged |
| `PATCH {quantity:5, unit_price:20, amount:100}` (the grid's consistent save) | stored as sent | stored as sent: 5 / 20 / 100, total 100 |
| `PATCH {"quantity":7}` | amount stale | amount 140, total 140 |
| `POST` line `{quantity:2, unit_price:10, amount:999}` | amount 999 | amount 20 |

| CRM (`crm_opportunity_line_item`, inputs not locked) | before | after |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `POST` line `{quantity:2, unit_price:10, amount:999}` | amount 999, `line_total` 999 | amount 20, `line_total` 20 |
| `PATCH {"quantity":3}` | amount stays 999, `line_total` 999 | amount 30, `line_total` 30 |

Seeds: all 5 seeded showcase lines already satisfy `amount == quantity * unit_price`, so every invoice `total` is identical before and after the boot (INV-1001 1619.96, INV-1002 198, INV-1003 299.94, INV-1004 450). The CRM seeds no line items.

## Census: stored, non-`formula` fields declaring `expression`

Every `expression:` key in the tree was scanned (`*.ts`, tests excluded) and each one's owning field was resolved: examples, `platform-objects`, plugins, services, `metadata-core`. Every other hit is a `Field.formula` / `type: 'formula'` or not a field. There are exactly two stored ones:

| Field | Writers | Readers |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `showcase_invoice_line.amount` (`invoice.object.ts`) | the console line-item grid (recomputes client-side and sends the computed value), the seed (5 rows, all consistent), the REST / MCP API (any value, before this PR). No hook, flow or import writes it. | `showcase_invoice.total` summary, and through it `revenue-pulse.dataset.ts`, `renewals-pipeline.page.ts` (chart + list), `invoice-document.page.ts` |
| `crm_opportunity_line_item.amount` (`opportunity-line-item.object.ts`) | the console grid (also `inlineAmountField: 'amount'` for the grid footer), the API. No seed, hook or flow. | `crm_opportunity.line_total` summary |

Before this PR, nothing said what a non-`formula` field's `expression` means on the server. The spec describe said only "Formula expression (CEL)". The lint (`validate-expressions.ts` field-formula pass) judges any field's `expression` as a CEL `value` expression, and no rule distinguishes stored from `formula`. `content/docs/data-modeling/validation-rules.mdx` lists `expression` under `formula` only. The two example comments said the server stores the client's value.

## The four-axis call (shape B over shape A)

- **Actual business need.** Measured: the card's paid-lock bypass, plus the stale or wrong stored `amount` on any unlocked line written through the API (showcase draft lines, every CRM line). An AI agent writing through MCP is exactly such a writer. Shape A (a `readonlyWhen` on the showcase `amount`) closes only the first. Shape B closes both, in both apps, with no per-app metadata.
- **Long-term soundness.** B is platform-first: one engine rule instead of every app remembering to copy its inputs' lock onto the derived column. Under A, `expression` on a stored field would stay a declared key the server does not honour.
- **Preventing AI authoring errors.** Under B, declaring an `expression` is what enforces it. An author or agent who declares `expression` on a stored field gets the computation it declared, and an agent that sends a wrong or stale value cannot store it.
- **Startup-stage scope.** No new spec key, export, error code or gate. B gives an existing, consumed key the meaning both producers already assumed.
- **Overwrite, not refuse.** A whole-record round-trip (form save, read-modify-write, the grid) echoes the stored `amount` back. Refusing a value that differs would turn those writes into 400s. The platform's precedent for a runtime-owned value is to accept the write and not store the caller's value (the `formula` and read-only strips). The one refusal is the predicate update that cannot be expressed as one statement. That follows the bulk `readonlyWhen` strip's fail-safe rule, and uses the existing `VALIDATION_FAILED` / `invalid_value` (checked first: `FieldErrorCode` in `packages/spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts`, plus the engine's `ReadonlyFieldRejectedError` / `readonly-strict-errors.ts` codes, which describe dropped locks, not a per-row computation).

## Pins

`packages/objectql/src/engine-stored-expression-write.test.ts` (14 cases, the real engine over a real-shaped driver):

- the card's two writes on a paid line: the `/batch`-shaped update keeps `quantity` 6, stores `amount` 299.94, reports exactly `[quantity] readonly_when`, and leaves `total` 299.94. The `amount`-only PATCH stores 299.94 and leaves `total` 299.94;
- the unpaid control: the grid's consistent save is stored as sent;
- insert and update, each with no amount, a wrong amount and the right amount; batch insert per row; a patch that moves no input;
- `beforeUpdate` is handed the expression over the pre-strip row, and an input that a hook changes is recomputed;
- predicate update: one value stored; untouched when no input moves; refused (`VALIDATION_FAILED`, field `amount`, `invalid_value`) and nothing written when the values would differ per row;
- a stored field that is `readonly` and declares `expression`, updated by id with its value and a moved input: the caller's value is reported as a `readonly` drop and refused under `strictReadonlyWrites`, and the stored value is the expression's (fix round 1; ablation with pass 1 on the recording payload: 2 failed | 12 passed).

**Ablation.** The test imports `./engine.js` relatively, so it runs source, not `dist`. With `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the planner's guard (`if (def && typeof def === 'object' && def.type !== 'formula' && def.expression) {`) was replaced by `if (false && …`. The mutation landed (anchor 1 → 0, blob `fd733c5e5f21` → `c7fc76a3bea4`): **10 failed | 2 passed**. Every paid-line pin is red. The two that stay green are the consistent grid save and the no-input patch, whose behaviour is the same either way. Restored: blob after restore `fd733c5e5f21` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

**Pin sweep.** `git grep -n "expression" -- '*.object.ts'` and the tests naming `showcase_invoice_line` / `crm_opportunity_line_item` were read. No existing pin asserts a client-sent stored-expression value. The dogfood persona matrix inserts a showcase line with no `unit_price`, which now stores `amount` `null`, as it did before (absent). No `readonly_when` pin moves: the drop set on the paid line is unchanged.

## Verification record

Head of record: `c22a069d3` (fix round 1; round 0 was `c01e06227`) (`origin/main` `cc95f5e63` merged in; the incoming commits touch none of `packages/objectql`, `packages/spec` or `examples/`).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: **449 files / 8461 tests passed**.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: **702 files / 21349 passed, 1 todo**.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test:repo`: 6 files / 82 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase test`: 36 files / 431 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-crm test`: 6 files / 46 passed.
- typecheck, exit 0 each, re-run after the merge: `@objectstack/objectql` (incl. `check:test-typecheck`), `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/example-showcase`, `@objectstack/example-crm`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: one stale artifact (`content/docs/references/**`), regenerated with `gen:docs`, then "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date", re-run after the merge.
- Fix round 1: the 116 families derived for this round's paths were re-run on `c22a069d3`, all exit 0 (`--ran`: a DERIVED zero). The other two of the 118 read only the two example objects, byte-identical to `c01e06227`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 118 families. All 118 were re-run on the head of record `c01e06227`, and **all exited 0**. `--ran`: "118 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 118 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 118 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
  - On the first pass, three families did not pass. `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: unbuilt `client-react` and 7 other packages); both passed after building those packages. `check:objectql-double-limit` exited 1 because the new suite's `find` double was limit-blind; the double now honours the bound and the gate exits 0.
  - The repository was deepened first (`--shallow-since=2026-07-13`) for `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` and `check-plugin-teardown-shape`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not closed by either shape: adding a line to a paid invoice.** `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_invoice_line` on the paid INV-1003 is accepted, before and after this PR, and moves its `total`, because `readonlyWhen` is exempt on INSERT by design. Measured before the fix: total 1 → 8 with a 7.00 line. Reported to the seat as a finding; not fixed here.
- `ObjectQL.validate()` (the insert dry-run) does not compute stored expressions. Its preview of `amount` is the caller's value.
- The fault log for a stored expression that does not evaluate reuses the `formula` sentence ("formula field 'amount' … reads null").
- A stored `currency` field that declares no `scale` stores the evaluator's double unrounded, as a `formula` does (`3 * 0.1` → `0.30000000000000004`). Both examples' seeded values are exact.
- The console grid was not driven in a browser (no `../objectui` in this container). The grid recomputes the same product client-side, so its consistent saves are stored as sent, as the API measurement of the same payload shows.
- This PR touches no governed surface.
